_comment: Ruleset for pretooluse-guard.sh. One object per rule: tool (exact tool name — one rule per tool), pattern (extended regex matched against file_path for Read/Edit/Write and against command for Bash), reason (shown to Claude on deny). IMPORTANT: every file-protection rule needs its Bash companion — blocking only Write/Edit leaves shell redirects open.

rules.reason: Writing secret files is blocked. Use a secrets manager.
Touching secret files via shell commands is blocked as well.
